thread:
Maya: Heads-up: Okta->SCIM provisioning spiked errors after the KMS alias rotation this morning. Users reporting provisioning 502s and deprovisions failing. Anyone triaging? :rotating_light:

Dan: I see a rush of KMS Decrypt errors in CloudTrail around 04:12. Looks like alias scim-envelope was repointed.

Ellie: Provisioner logs show a failed unwrap path, sample:

```
time=2024-04-10T04:12:22Z level=error msg=\"jwe unwrap failed: decrypt: IncorrectKeyMaterial\" request=svc-123
```

Maya: IncorrectKeyMaterial usually means the key material type changed (symmetric vs asymmetric). Did we rotate to an RSA key by mistake?

Theo: I pushed the alias change from infra-config earlier but the key selected appears to be an asymmetric key created for signing. The alias selection logic matched on tag 'env=prod' but we didn't enforce KeySpec.

Dan: Also noticed RBAC for kms:Decrypt calls looks intact. No deny rules. So this is a key-type compatibility issue, not permissions. Audit logs were delayed ~40s which slowed detection.

Ellie: Short-term: rolling alias back to previous CMK (symmetrical AES) should allow provisioner to decrypt existing envelopes. However, any envelopes rewrapped with the asymmetric key will be unreadable. Do we know if any rewrap job ran?

Maya: No automated re-encrypt job ran. We only updated the alias mapping as part of the rotation. Good news.

Theo: Rolling back now. PR: https://git.internal/infra/alias-fixes/PR-917 — deploying rollback.

deploy-bot: alias-fixes/PR-917 merged, deployment started.

Alex (via DM to Theo): Recommend temporarily throttling SCIM syncs for impacted tenants until we validate.

Theo: Throttled syncs for 10 impacted accounts; provisioning success rate is returning to normal after alias rollback.

Maya: Action items to prevent recurrence:
- Dan: add a pre-rotate verification that checks KeySpec/KeyUsage (must be SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT and ENCRYPT_DECRYPT) and fail the alias change if mismatch.
- Ellie: update identity-provisioner to surface explicit error messages when KMS returns IncorrectKeyMaterial (include key id + alias).
- Theo: add a 10-minute staged canary and require manual sign-off for alias changes in prod runbook.
- Security (Maya): run a search for failed decrypts and cross-check whether any tenant data was affected; escalate if matches found.

Ellie: I'll also add a guard in the provisioning CI that simulates alias swap to an incompatible key and expects the pre-rotate check to block it.

Dan: Note: we should also record the alias-change as a config-change event in our audit index that links to KMS CloudTrail entries (helps post-incident forensics).

Maya: Good point. Add to runbook: create an audit correlation step for KMS alias ops.

Theo: Post-rollback monitoring shows KMS Decrypt errors dropped to baseline. SCIM 502s resolved for all impacted customers.

Maya: Drafting postmortem and will include timeline, root cause (alias pointed to asymmetric key used for signing), and action items. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

Theo: Also suggest we add explicit RBAC test where a service account tries Decrypt with a wrong key type to ensure errors are diagnosed quickly in the future.

Maya: Agreed, add that to the safety playbook.
